### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/dogfood`, touching **5** documentable anchor(s).

**22** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5bd72570d2752135554882011808da798dff528b`.

⛔ **13** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `os dev (command, 44 pages)`, `os serve (command, 51 pages)`
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **42** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5bd72570d2752135554882011808da798dff528b` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c0bfa7f1780a3dd865722c07c5d420043e21919e` — the merge of head `392fd9a2d2306fa8ac758e39b9de47c73ccaa73e` into base `5bd72570d2752135554882011808da798dff528b`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c0bfa7f1780a3dd865722c07c5d420043e21919e && git checkout c0bfa7f1780a3dd865722c07c5d420043e21919e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 5bd72570d2752135554882011808da798dff528b 392fd9a2d2306fa8ac758e39b9de47c73ccaa73e && git checkout -B drift-repro 5bd72570d2752135554882011808da798dff528b && git merge --no-ff 392fd9a2d2306fa8ac758e39b9de47c73ccaa73e

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5bd72570d2752135554882011808da798dff528b
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 5bd72570d2752135554882011808da798dff528b` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：`os dev`、`os start`、`os serve --dev`、`os environments bind --build` 在配置编译子进程失败时，收尾行不再说“Compile failed”，改为“objectstack.config did not load or compile — the reason is printed above; fix it before …”。`os dev` 监听重编译的失败行同样改了。
- 为什么做：按你的裁决 D（中性措辞、不分类），配置加载时被拒也走这一行，旧文案会让人去找代码错误。
- 出错会怎样：只改文案；退出码、错误码、子进程输出都不变。
- 要你做什么：不需要你做任何事，区域审完自己落地。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-a) · repo:objectstack#1 · head `c041c7fe3e4856b4737d4f0ba6ae6fcfead2e417` · 2026-11-19T10:53Z

- **形态** — draft, base `main`, 6 commits, 9 files, +140/−7. Merge-base `3819afec`. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 35463`: NOT governed, 147 lines ≤ 3000, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` ⇒ no L2 owed. `Fixes #32439` is right: the card closes on ruling D.
- **Ruling D (6998194814) conditions, read against the diff** — (1) neutral at the four named sites `dev.ts`, `start.ts`, `serve.ts`, `environments/bind.ts`, each in its `status !== 0` branch: yes. (2) True for a syntax error, a thrown refusal and a print-then-exit refusal ("did not load or compile — the reason is printed above"): yes, it classifies nothing. (3) Says neither "compile error" nor "refused": yes, pinned per site. (4) Each site keeps its tail and `start.ts` keeps the `--artifact` hint: yes. (5) No new exit status, error code or cloud change: none. The fifth site (`dev.ts` watch recompile, `✗ compile failed (Nms)` → `✗ objectstack.config did not load or compile (Nms)`) prints on the same child-non-zero condition with the same claim, so it is the same closing line; it rightly drops "above" because its relayed output follows it. `child-env-source-loader.pin.test.ts` comment quote updated as the ruling asks.
- **Pins** — `compile-child-failure-line.pin.test.ts` (source pin, reason given: driving the boot sites needs the built CLI): exactly one code line with the phrase per site, its tail, a `.status !== 0` within 8 lines above, no "compile error"/"refused", and no code line with `\bcompile failed\b` per file. The watch line is driven for real in the existing `dev-watch-compile-refusal.pin.test.ts` harness at both exit statuses (2 and 1). Ablations red 3/14 and 2/8, restored (PR body).
- **The 11 `vi.mock` factories** — added because `check:test-source-alias` judges an edited test file and its source reach finds 11 dynamic loads through `dev.ts`; the watch loop under test calls none of them. A gate-satisfying answer in the test file only, no production change; accepted.
- **Changeset** — `@objectstack/cli` patch (published), read sentence by sentence: the four commands and old line; "the parent sees only the child's exit status"; the new phrase with each tail; the watch line; "Nothing classifies the failure: exit statuses, error codes and the text the child prints are unchanged"; the script-migration line — all match. nit: `serve.ts` prints the actual relative config path, not the literal `objectstack.config` (the PR body table says so; the changeset's generic spelling is close enough).
- **门禁** — 58 check-runs on this head: 40 success, 18 skipped, 0 failure; Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check `success`. Local derived sets: 70/73 and 44/46 exit 0, the NOT MEASURED families (exit 3 prerequisites) all run in CI's green Lint & Repo Gates.
- **接受的偏差** — `packages/qa/dogfood/bench/sql-perf/bench.mjs:194` is an area-granted file-surface addendum: the diff would otherwise leave its `includes('Compile failed')` boot check dead. Repo-wide `git grep -i "compile failed\|fix errors above"` at this head finds no other code or published-doc consumer of the old line (remaining hits are comments, this PR's own pins, and CHANGELOGs).
- **范围外去向** — `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json` items[0].variants[6] still says `os dev` "exits 1 with 'Compile failed — fix errors above before starting dev server'". Internal QA prose, not shipped, outside the claimed surface, already named in the PR body: **follow-up owed** — b1-B files it (p3) or folds the one-line quote into the next PR that touches that file (batching rule).
- **落地条款** — not governed: b1-B lands this head after this ACCEPT. A new push needs a fresh L1 only if it changes more than a main merge.
